title: 第523章 击杀黑魔
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“人呢？”

黑魔走进来后眼角在屋子里扫视了一下，没有发现云峰的尸体，便询问张冉冉。

可张冉冉忽然笑了起来，陈妙也笑了起来，两人都笑得很诡异。

“你们笑什么？”

黑魔顿时感觉不妙，他猛地回过了头，却发现身后的一个椅子上也不知道什么时候多了一个人，一个正在抽烟的人。

正是云峰。

“哦，你就是黑魔城主，就是你要杀我，让人下毒害我？”

云峰对着黑魔吐出来一个烟雾，淡淡道。

“你们两个贱女人出卖我？”

黑魔这才反应了过来，就要拍死张冉冉和陈妙，不过就在此刻云峰动了，他将手上的香烟轻轻一弹。

香烟化为一道利剑一样狠狠轰在了黑魔的胸口，将黑魔轰得飞了出去。

黑魔整个人直接撞在了房子的墙壁上，将墙壁都撞出一个大窟窿，他趴在地上大口吐血，嘴里的牙齿也不知道掉了多少颗。

看到这一幕，张冉冉和陈妙都惊呆了，毕竟这个人可是黑魔城主啊，传说中神帝城最强的存在，如此厉害的人物被云峰用一根香烟打飞。

“找死！”

“混账！”

看到黑魔被打得像条狗一样，那四个黑魔带过来的手下顿时大怒，纷纷对云峰发动了攻击。

四张泛着红光的手掌狠狠朝着云峰的身体拍了过来。

这四个家伙都是二类渡劫修士，也是神帝城四大护法，本来是很强的了，可惜他们却不是云峰的对手。

他们的掌力全部轰在了云峰的护体光盾上，却没破开光盾。

云峰手一动，从身上取出来一把长剑，然后。

长剑直接将眼前的四大护法切成了碎片，四大护法毕竟是渡劫期修士，神魂则从身体里飞了出来要逃走，可惜云峰口一张，直接就将四道蓝光神魂吞服了下去。

这神魂拥有他们强大的能量，和妖兽的妖丹一样，是能提升云峰的修为的。

“味道不错。”

吞掉了四个渡劫修士的神魂后，云峰用手摸了摸嘴巴笑道。

而此刻的黑魔则惊呆了，他万万没想到云峰强悍到了如此地步。

“大人，我错了，我不该害你。”

黑魔忙跪在地上求饶，毕竟云峰太强了，他压根不是云峰的对手，他也很后悔，干什么算计云峰，把自己逼迫到了如此下场。

“现在才知道错，太晚了。”

云峰冷冷道，他大手一伸直接将黑魔抓了过来，用手掐住了其脖子，直接使用了吸精大法。

瞬间功夫，黑魔就被吸成了一具干硬的尸体，死得不能再死了。

看到云峰如此恐怖的邪术，一旁的张冉冉和陈妙吓了一跳，不过想到云峰是拯救了她们的人，应该不会对她们怎么样，悬着的心也放了下来。

“你们拿着黄金离开这个城池吧。”

云峰看着张冉冉和陈妙道，毕竟她们两个是手无缚鸡之力的女人，留在这里也十分危险，难保黑魔的残余手下不会找她们的麻烦。

“云大人，我想跟随你。”

不过张冉冉犹豫了一下说道。

Page (1/3)

"Where are the people?"

After the black devil walked in, he scanned the room with his eyes. He didn't find Yunfeng's body, so he asked Zhang Ranran.

But Zhang Ranran suddenly laughed, and Chen Miao also laughed, both of them laughing very strangely.

"What are you laughing at?"

The Black Devil suddenly felt something bad. He turned around suddenly, only to find that someone had appeared on a chair behind him, a man smoking.

It is Yunfeng.

"Oh, you are the Lord of the Black Demon City. Are you the one who wants to kill me and have me poisoned?"

Yunfeng blew out a smoke towards the black devil and said calmly.

"You two bitches betrayed me?"

Only then did the black devil react and was about to beat Zhang Ranran and Chen Miao to death, but at this moment Yunfeng moved and flicked the cigarette in his hand.

The cigarette turned into a sharp sword and hit the Black Demon's chest hard, sending the Dark Demon flying out.

The black devil hit the wall of the house directly, knocking a big hole out of the wall. He lay on the ground and vomited blood. He didn't know how many teeth fell out of his mouth.

Seeing this scene, Zhang Ranran and Chen Miao were both shocked. After all, this person was the Lord of the Black Demon City, the legendary strongest being in the God Emperor City. Such a powerful figure was beaten away by Yunfeng with a cigarette.

"Seeking death!"

"Asshole!"

Seeing the Black Demon being beaten like a dog, the four men brought over by the Black Demon were furious and launched attacks on Yunfeng one after another.

Four glowing red palms fiercely slapped Yunfeng's body.

These four guys are all second-class tribulation-transcending monks and the four guardians of the God Emperor City. They were already very strong, but unfortunately they were no match for Yunfeng.

All their palms hit Yunfeng's protective light shield, but they did not break the light shield.

Yunfeng moved his hand, took out a long sword from his body, and then.

The long sword directly cut the four guardians in front of him into pieces. After all, the four guardians were monks in the tribulation stage, and the souls flew out of the body to escape. Unfortunately, Yunfeng opened his mouth and swallowed the four blue-light souls.

This soul has their powerful energy, and like the monster's demon pill, it can improve Yunfeng's cultivation.

“It tastes good.”

After swallowing the souls of the four tribulation monks, Yunfeng touched his mouth with his hand and smiled.

At this moment, Black Demon was stunned. He never expected that Yunfeng was so powerful.

"Sir, I was wrong, I shouldn't have harmed you."

Hei Mo hurriedly knelt on the ground and begged for mercy. After all, Yunfeng was too strong and he was no match for Yunfeng. He also regretted why he had plotted against Yunfeng and forced himself to end up like this.

"I realize my mistake now, it's too late."

Yunfeng said coldly, he stretched out his big hand and grabbed the black devil, strangled his neck with his hands, and directly used the semen-absorbing technique.

In an instant, the black devil was sucked into a dry and hard corpse, too dead to die.

Seeing Yunfeng's terrifying sorcery, Zhang Ranran and Chen Miao were shocked, but they were relieved to think that Yunfeng was the one who saved them and would not do anything to them.

"Take the gold and leave this city."

Yunfeng looked at Zhang Ranran and Chen Miaodao. After all, they were two weak women, and it was very dangerous to stay here. There was no guarantee that the remaining men of the Black Devil would not cause trouble for them.

"Master Yun, I want to follow you."

But Zhang Ranran hesitated and said.
